title: Kenyan Bread Casserole
description: A hearty Kenyan-inspired bread casserole, perfect for a comforting meal. This dish combines the warmth of traditional Kenyan spices with the simplicity of a bread-based casserole.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté chopped onions and bell peppers until softened.
Add Kenyan spices, salt, and luscious tomato sauce. Simmer for 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix bread cubes and a pinch of salt.
In a 9x13-inch casserole dish, create a layer of bread mixture, followed by a layer of the tomato sauce mixture. Repeat this process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of bread.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
